name: La Coursiere
source:
An unknown voice commands you through the city, telling you precisely when you need to run, walk or blend in. You follow the instructions. You trust that voice... to guide you out of your pursuers' way.

[From  [url=https://atpprojects.itch.io/lacoursiere]official site[/url]]
translation:
一个未知的声音命令你穿过城市，准确地告诉你何时需要跑步、行走或融入其中。你按照指示进行操作。你相信那个声音……会引导你摆脱追捕者的道路。

[来自[url=https://atpprojects.itch.io/lacoursiere]官方网站[/url]]
